description_en: Applies for an SMS qualification. According to the real-name registration requirements of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) and carriers, qualification certificate information of the signature owner is required for domestic SMS messages. Apply for an SMS qualification before applying for signatures and templates
description_zh: 根据工信部及运营商实名制发送短信的要求，国内短信需提供签名归属方的资质证件信息。请先申请短信资质，然后再申请签名和模板

name: SubmitSmsQualification

parameters.example: 阿里云云通信有限公司资质李华
parameters.help_en: The name of the qualification. It is used to manage and distinguish multiple qualifications you apply for and does not appear in SMS content. The name cannot be the same as an existing qualification name. It supports only Chinese characters, English letters, or a combination of letters and digits. Symbols and pure digits are not supported. The length cannot exceed 100 characters
parameters.help_zh: 资质名称，用于管理、区分您申请的多个资质，不会出现在短信内容中。名称不可与已有资质名称重复，仅支持中文、英文或与数字组合，不支持任何符号或纯数字输入，长度不超过100字符

parameters.help_en:
The name of the administrator. The length cannot exceed 50 characters. Under the current https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2873145.html, if the same administrator applies for qualifications for multiple different enterprises, the registration will fail. Ensure one administrator per enterprise to improve the registration success rate.

The administrator (also known as the handler) refers to the person who logs on to the Alibaba Cloud account and manages the SMS business. Generally, this is the operations personnel who manages the qualifications, signatures, and templates under this Alibaba Cloud account and sends SMS messages, and whose mobile phone number can receive verification codes. The administrator is not necessarily the administrator of this Alibaba Cloud account, and the administrator can be the same person as the legal person of the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:

管理员（又称经办人）指登录阿里云账号并管理短信业务的人员，一般是贵方管理此阿里云账号下资质、签名和模板，并进行短信发送的相关运营人员，且此人手机号可接收验证码。管理员不一定是此阿里云账号的管理员，管理员可以与企业法人为同一人

parameters.help_en:
Qualification authorization. Specifies whether you agree to share qualifications with other Cloud Communications products (such as domestic voice and domestic number privacy protection). Qualifications can be shared and reused only when you apply for a self-use qualification and the qualification information is consistent with the enterprise information verified for the current Alibaba Cloud account. It is invalid in other cases. Valid values:

true: Agree. Your qualification information can be invoked during the qualification verification phase of other Cloud Communications products, exempting you from repeated verification.
false: Disagree
parameters.help_zh:
资质授权，是否同意与其他云通信产品（如国内语音、国内号码隐私保护）的资质共享。仅当您申请自用资质，且资质信息与当前阿里云账号认证企业信息一致时可被共享、复用；其他情况无效。取值：

true：同意，您的资质信息可在其他云通信产品的“资质认证环节”调用，免除重复认证环节。
false：不同意
